name: Krieger Coetequix
source:
A high-ranking cultist of the Weeping Angels who is obsessed with her sister.

[spoiler]As well as a former member of Aeroseven BKT who would go on to betray the Weeping Angels in favor of the Black Lotus Society.[/spoiler]
